exact_source_bullets: AI is a tool for assistance, information, pattern and trend detection, and routine-task support.
AI cannot determine rider ability or horse lameness.
Consequential legal, financial, medical, welfare, safeguarding, ownership, and access decisions remain human-authority zones.
EquineSync customer operational data will not be used to train General or Shared Models.
Provider-neutral architecture, minimum-necessary disclosure, strong retention controls, and vendor exit capability are required.
The five-tier decision framework is approved.
AI outputs must be labeled, source-grounded, transparent about fact versus inference, explicit about estimates, and candid about uncertainty.
AI must refuse unsupported conclusions and request more information when appropriate.
AI output is not automatically canonical, users may challenge it, and AI inherits the user's narrowest permissions.
Identifiable cross-tenant learning is prohibited; minors, offline use, financial use, and equine-health use receive enhanced safeguards.

Health-risk scoring, feed recommendations, behavioral or risk scoring, automatic collections, financial forecasting, and supervised workflow automation are permitted launch candidates within the boundaries of this Model.
